# telnyx_storage_object_presigned_url (Ephemeral Resource)

A presigned URL that grants temporary access to one object in a Telnyx Cloud Storage bucket without credentials. It is never stored in plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A link to one object that works without credentials for an hour. It is
# created on every run and never stored.
ephemeral "telnyx_storage_object_presigned_url" "report" {
  bucket_name = "reports"
  object_name = "2026-11.csv"
  ttl         = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The bucket name.
- `object_name` (String) The object name.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) The time to live of the token in seconds The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `content` (Attributes, Sensitive) The presigned URL and when it expires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content))

<a id="nestedatt--content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String, Sensitive) The expiration time of the token
- `presigned_url` (String, Sensitive) The presigned URL for the object
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token for the object
